name: Can crown molding be installed over bathroom wall tile?

mainEntity.name: Can crown molding be installed over bathroom wall tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, crown molding can be added over or directly against bathroom wall tile, but it requires specific installation techniques. Instead of nailing directly into hard tile, trim carpenters secure a wood backer block to the wall studs above the tile line, then fasten the crown molding to that backer. If the tile reaches the ceiling, specialized masonry bits and construction adhesives are used to anchor the trim. Caulking the transition joint with a flexible, mildew-resistant sealant prevents water vapor from seeping behind the tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, crown molding can be installed above or against tile by anchoring it to wood nailer strips or using specialty masonry fasteners and waterproof adhesive.
